name: fix-cheats-1.6.1
desc: Cheats Interface 1.6.1 - the cheat window exists only in play (city/sea/land scene of the loaded save), never on the title screen or while loading.
commits: fix(cheats): show the cheat window only in play (Interface 1.6.1)

The window, H and O now require the loaded save to be the current PlayerDataManager data and a city/sea/land scene that is entered and not loading. Previously Player stayed set after returning to the title, so the window appeared on the title screen.
